subject: MAP: proposed lock-window + retention carveouts needed for close
messages:
From: Ashley Harris <ashley.harris@sablefin.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: tom.delgado@sablefin.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security lane questions and retention carveouts

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks for the MAP template you shared earlier. We're trying to lock the close timeline for our pilot and need to scope the security/compliance lane so we can get procurement and legal to commit. A few asks from our side before we finalize dates: 

- SOC 2: we need a short gap matrix showing where Redwood meets our control expectations and any compensating controls for gaps. Can you commit to delivering that by Apr 6?
- SIG/CAIQ: we'd prefer a completed CAIQ or an updated questionnaire with notes for any answers pending evidence.
- DPA: legal has redlined a small set of DPA points (I'll attach the summary). We need to agree the retention carveouts (particularly for EU PII) before signature.
- Evidence access: our security ops will want read-only access to the SOC 2 report and a place to upload/validate evidence during the eval.

Target close: Apr 21. If we can't get the SOC 2 gap matrix and DPA carveouts resolved this week, procurement will push the signature to May. Can your security lead weigh in on the timetables?

Thanks,
Ashley
Director of Vendor Security
Sable Financial
[Attachment: Sable_DPA_comments.pdf (pdf)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ashley Harris <ashley.harris@sablefin.com>, Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@sablefin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security lane questions and retention carveouts

Hi Ashley / Tom — thanks for the clear list. High level: we can meet the Apr 21 target if we align on a short lock-window for security deliverables this week. Proposed plan below (I attached an editable MAP spreadsheet with milestones):

1) Today (Apr 1): Redwood sends SOC 2 gap matrix (controls mapped to your asks) + CAIQ status summary (note items under evidence collection).
2) By Apr 3: Karthik to provide answers to any high-risk CAIQ items and a suggested mitigation timeline for gaps that require engineering changes.
3) By Apr 6: Agree DPA carveouts for EU PII residency/retention; Redwood provides draft language for a retention addendum if needed.
4) Apr 7–12: Evidence intake window — we will provide read-only links to our SOC 2 report and an evidence bucket; your security ops can validate during this window.
5) Apr 13–16: Final redline consolidation and signoff readiness; procurement/legal review.

If any critical item can't be closed by Apr 6 we mutually agree to a one-week extension to the MAP lock-window; otherwise we proceed to DocuSign by Apr 18.

Attachments: Sable_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone owners)

I'll loop Karthik for technical risk and retention specifics. Marissa — can you keep procurement in the loop and own the HubSpot close tasks?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Sable_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ashley Harris <ashley.harris@sablefin.com>, Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@sablefin.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security lane questions and retention carveouts

Thanks, Soojin. Quick technical run-down and acceptance criteria so everyone has clarity: 

- SOC 2 gap matrix: we'll deliver a control-by-control map that highlights current status (meets / partially meets / in progress), evidence location, and remediation ETA for any gaps. Delivery: Apr 3 COB.

- CAIQ/SIG: CAIQ will be provided as an annotated export showing evidence links for each affirmative response. Any items marked 'in progress' will include a short mitigation note and owner. Expect this with the gap matrix (Apr 3).

- DPA / retention: Redwood standard DPA supports configurable retention windows by tenant. For Sable Financial we propose: 
  - Default session logs: 30 days
  - Production request logs (metadata): 90 days
  - PII-derived embeddings: 0 retention by default unless you opt in; we can support 90-day retention if required with additional controls.

EU residency: if you require EU-only hosting for the pilot, we can provision a private VPC instance in EU region; lead time ~3 weeks. If EU residency is not required for pilot, we recommend EU residency only for production.

- Evidence access: we'll publish a read-only link to the SOC 2 summary PDF and provide a temporary S3 bucket with scoped creds for evidence intake (audit-only access).

Risks: The only schedule blocker is EU residency requirement — that pushes the provisioning timeline and hence the close. If Sable confirms EU residency not required for pilot by Apr 3, we are on track for Apr 21.

I'll attach the SOC2_gap_matrix.pdf draft separately in case legal/security want to pre-read.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_gap_matrix.pdf (pdf)]

From: Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@sablefin.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ashley Harris <ashley.harris@sablefin.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2026 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security lane questions and retention carveouts

Karthik / Soojin — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple quick confirmations from Sable legal/security after reviewing the materials: 

- SOC 2 gap matrix received and internal security is satisfied with the compensating controls for the few partially-met items.
- CAIQ annotated export looks good; we'll follow up on two minor evidence links but those don't block signoff.
- EU residency: for the pilot we do NOT require EU-only hosting, so the provisioning delay is avoided. Production residency will be a separate requirement to finalize later.
- DPA retention: legal is comfortable with the proposed defaults. They asked that Redwood include the retention table as an annex to the DPA (simple table with buckets and durations). Please share a DPA draft with the annex inserted by Apr 9.

Next steps: Marissa / Soojin — please share the DocuSign envelope and DPA draft with annex (we'll queue procurement review). If we get the DPA draft by Apr 9 and procurement signs the MAP actions, we remain on track for the Apr 21 close.

Thanks,
Tom Delgado
Senior Procurement Manager
Sable Financial
[Inline: "On Thu, Apr 2, 2026 at 08:17 Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Risks: The only schedule blocker is EU residency requirement — that pushes the provisioning timeline and hence the close.

Got it — not required for pilot. Happy to proceed."]
